content.short: Volo is a leading liquid staking protocol on Sui that optimizes yield and capital efficiency via the vSUI token.
content.description: Volo is a premier decentralized liquid staking protocol built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide users with a highly liquid and yield-bearing version of their staked assets. By allowing participants to stake SUI tokens and receive vSUI in return, the platform enables them to earn network staking rewards while maintaining total capital liquidity. This ensures that users can deploy their vSUI across other DeFi protocols—such as lending markets and liquidity pools—to maximize their overall returns. Volo serves as a vital layer that standardizes staking on Sui.
content.meta: Volo provides decentralized liquid staking on Sui through the yield-bearing vSUI token. Discover Volo and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
